title: [SPR1-001] Run MkDocs locally via Docker
body:
Objective: run docs locally without pip/venv hassles.

DoD:
- docker-compose service `docs` using `squidfunk/mkdocs-material:latest`.
- Makefile targets: `docs-up` / `docs-down` / `docs-build`.
- README updated with Docker quickstart.

Acceptance:
- `docker compose up docs` serves http://127.0.0.1:8000

Estimate: 1 pt

title: [SPR1-002] Repo toolchain: Makefile, pre-commit, Conventional Commits, PR template
body:
Objective: baseline DevEx.

DoD:
- Makefile targets `up/down/test/lint/format`.
- Local hooks or pre-commit for lint/format.
- `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` with ADR/CHANGELOG/Contracts checklist.
- Documented in README.

Acceptance:
- New PR shows the template and passes local hooks.

Estimate: 2 pts

title: [SPR1-003] Minimal CI workflow: build + unit tests
body:
Objective: basic GitHub Actions CI.

DoD:
- Workflow runs build, linters and unit tests.
- Dependency caching enabled.

Acceptance:
- Pipeline runs on each PR to `main` and is green.

Estimate: 2 pts

title: [SPR1-004] OpenAPI v1 scaffold: tenants, accounts, banks, transactions
body:
Objective: initial /v1 contract for baseline CRUD stubs.

DoD:
- `docs/contracts/openapi/v1/openapi.yaml` with paths: /v1/tenants, /v1/accounts, /v1/banks, /v1/transactions.
- Problem Details (RFC7807).
- `Idempotency-Key` header on mutations.
- OpenAPI CHANGELOG updated.

Acceptance:
- Spec validates with no errors.

Estimate: 3 pts

title: [SPR1-005] Tenant & User aggregates (in-memory) with basic RBAC
body:
Objective: model tenant and users with roles OWNER/ADMIN/USER.

DoD:
- Domain aggregates and in-memory ports.
- Invariant: creator gets OWNER on tenant creation.
- Controller stubs wired to app services.

Acceptance (Gherkin):
```
Given simulated auth
When POST /v1/tenants
Then a tenant UUID is created and the caller is OWNER
```

Estimate: 3 pts

title: [SPR1-006] Account aggregate (currency enforced: USD/EUR/COP)
body:
Objective: CHECKING/SAVINGS accounts with fixed currency.

DoD:
- Account aggregate with currency validation.
- Uniqueness (tenantId, accountName) enforced in app layer (for now).
- Stubs `POST/GET /v1/accounts`.

Acceptance:
- Reject currencies outside {USD, EUR, COP}.

Estimate: 3 pts

title: [SPR1-007] Bank entity + API stub (in-memory)
body:
Objective: bank entity per tenant with CRUD endpoints.

DoD:
- `bank` model with name, code, metadata; tenant-scoped.
- `/v1/banks` (create/list/get/delete) in-memory.

Acceptance:
- Bank created is visible only to its tenant.

Estimate: 2 pts

title: [SPR1-008] Transactions API stub with bankId + Idempotency-Key
body:
Objective: expose /v1/transactions (in-memory) including bankId.

DoD:
- DTO: accountId, bankId, amount, currency, bookingDate, sourceId.
- Idempotency by (route, Idempotency-Key) in-memory.

Acceptance (Gherkin):
```
Given a valid bankId
When POST /v1/transactions with Idempotency-Key
Then the first call returns 201 and the second returns 200 with the same body
```

Estimate: 3 pts

title: [SPR1-009] DTO validation + unified Problem Details (RFC7807)
body:
Objective: Bean Validation and uniform error handling.

DoD:
- DTO annotations (size, pattern, ISO-8601 dates, currency).
- `@ControllerAdvice` returning RFC7807 with `traceId`.

Acceptance:
- Invalid POST returns 400 `application/problem+json` with `traceId`.

Estimate: 2 pts

title: [SPR1-010] Domain unit tests (tenant/account/bank/transaction stub)
body:
Objective: ≥70% coverage for domain logic touched in this sprint.

DoD:
- Invariant + happy path tests.
- No flaky tests; descriptive names.

Acceptance:
- CI shows ≥70% coverage for domain packages modified.

Estimate: 3 pts

title: [SPR1-011] Contract test for POST /v1/accounts and /v1/transactions
body:
Objective: seed CDC for core endpoints.

DoD:
- Consumer-side test or Spring Cloud Contract stub.
- Verify status codes, Idempotency-Key header, response shape.

Acceptance:
- Stubs pass in CI.

Estimate: 2 pts

title: [SPR1-012] Health endpoint + smoke test
body:
Objective: `/health` endpoint and simple smoke test in CI.

DoD:
- Spring Actuator health (or custom `/health`) enabled in dev.
- Smoke script verifying 200 OK.

Acceptance:
- `make test` runs smoke locally; CI too.

Estimate: 1 pt

title: [SPR1-013] Security headers + dependency scan baseline
body:
Objective: establish a security baseline.

DoD:
- Response headers: CSP (report-only OK in dev), HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy.
- Dependency scan (Trivy or OWASP dep check) in CI.

Acceptance:
- Dev responses include headers.
- CI publishes scan results.

Estimate: 2 pts

title: [SPR1-014] Seed ADRs + initial Scope CHANGELOG
body:
Objective: consolidate ADR-000..005 and scope-CHANGELOG.

DoD:
- Files under `/docs/architecture/decisions/` and `/docs/governance/` present.
- PR template checklist references them.

Acceptance:
- MkDocs shows ADR index and scope CHANGELOG.

Estimate: 1 pt

title: [SPR1-015] Define Stitch prompt + Figma storyboard for onboarding & core UI
body:
Objective: produce a high-quality prompt for Stitch to generate screens, and a Figma storyboard covering onboarding and core features aligned with our architecture and constraints.

Deliverables (DoD)
- A single, copy-paste Stitch prompt (in the issue) generating:
  (1) Landing, (2) Auth (Auth0 Universal vs Custom), (3) Tenant setup,
  (4) Onboarding wizard (accounts, currencies, inline bank create tenant-scoped),
  (5) Dashboard (native + EUR/COP equivalents), (6) Transactions import,
  (7) Account detail (historical FX), (8) Loading/empty/error states.
- Figma file URL with named frames and a clickable onboarding prototype.
- Design tokens JSON for Tailwind/CSS variables.
- Accessibility notes (WCAG 2.1 AA) and i18n EN/ES keys.

Acceptance Criteria
- Inline bank creation in combobox persists immediately and is tenant-scoped.
- No separate banks CRUD page; creation occurs within flows.
- Responsive specs and state variants present.

Success Metrics
- Onboarding path completable in < 3 minutes in prototype.
- ≤ 30% manual edits required from Stitch output.

PROMPT
[Paste the long English prompt from the issue body here]

title: [SPR1-016] Spike: Auth0 Universal Login vs Custom sign-up
body:
Compare UX/dev effort/security/compliance.

Output: ADR-007 with the chosen approach and theming notes for Universal Login (if chosen).

Estimate: 2 pts.
